description: Defines the ModuleScreen class in the OrangeHRM system, representing a data transfer object (DTO) for a module screen with properties for module, screen, and overridden versions, including getter/setter methods and override functionalities.

classes.name: ModuleScreen
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating module and screen details along with overridden versions, used within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing module and screen properties, invoking override methods.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name, or null if not set.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name and triggers override if not already overridden.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen name, or null if not set.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen name and triggers override if not already overridden.
